# Exploring Multiple Traits

In this section, I explore the relationship between body mass
and flipper length.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = body_mass_g,
      y = flipper_length_mm,
      color = species
    )
  )
